simple.prompt: She ___ speak three Asian languages fluently.
simple.explanation: Modal 'can' tidak pernah mendapat akhiran -s, -ed, atau -ing, apa pun subjeknya (I can, he can, she can).

simple.prompt: After 'can', the main verb must always be in the base form: 'He can ___ the financial report.'
simple.explanation: Setelah modal auxiliary 'can', kata kerja utama WAJIB berupa bare infinitive (kata kerja dasar murni tanpa to dan tanpa -s): 'can analyze'.
hints: Gunakan bentuk dasar kata kerja (V1 murni).

simple.prompt: I am terribly sorry, but I ___ attend the team retrospective tomorrow.
simple.explanation: Bentuk negatif baku dari 'can' ditulis sebagai satu kata tanpa spasi: 'cannot' (atau bentuk singkatan 'can't').

simple.targetSentence: Can you drive a manual transmission car?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan modal: Can + Subject (you) + Verb dasar (drive) + Object.

simple.prompt: Excuse me, ___ I borrow your charger for a few minutes?
simple.explanation: 'Can I...?' digunakan secara umum untuk meminta izin (asking for permission).

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat negatif kemampuan menggunakan singkatan 'can't'.
simple.targetSentence: They can't access the database right now.
simple.explanation: Subject (They) + can't + Verb dasar (access) + Object + Time.

simple.prompt: Can your sister swim? — Yes, she ___.
simple.explanation: Jawaban singkat positif: 'Yes, she can.' (tanpa mengulang kata kerja utama).
hints: Cukup akhiri dengan modal: 'Yes, she can.'

simple.prompt: My colleague ___ speak both Japanese and Mandarin fluently.
simple.explanation: Modal verb 'can' bentuknya selalu tetap untuk semua subjek; tidak pernah mendapat akhiran -s.
hints: Modal 'can' tidak berubah walau subjeknya tunggal.

simple.prompt: After the software update, users can ___ spreadsheets in PDF format directly.
simple.explanation: Setelah modal 'can', verb utama wajib kembali ke bentuk dasar murni (tanpa 'to' maupun '-ing').
hints: Setelah modal verb selalu diikuti base verb.

simple.prompt: I'm afraid I ___ join the lunch meeting today because I have a dentist appointment.
___ you help me carry these projector cables to Room 4?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan dengan 'can' cukup membalik 'Can' ke depan subjek (tanpa 'do/are').
hints: Modal langsung berpindah ke awal kalimat tanya.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di ruang kerja dengan jawaban singkat 'can'.
dialogue: Technician
Can your laptop connect to the guest Wi-Fi network?
Intern
Yes, it ___. The signal is quite strong here.
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan diawali 'Can', maka jawaban singkat wajib memakai 'can' kembali.
hints: Pertanyaan modal dijawab dengan modal yang sama.

simple.prompt: Without a valid access card, visitors ___ enter the laboratory wing.
simple.explanation: Menyatakan ketidakmampuan atau larangan akses memakai 'can't' atau 'cannot' diikuti verb dasar 'enter'.
hints: Subjek jamak dan tunggal memakai bentuk sama.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan umum penambahan 'to' setelah modal 'can' berikut.
simple.draft: Our team can to finish the prototype before Friday afternoon.
options: Our team can finish the prototype before Friday afternoon.
Our team cans finish the prototype before Friday afternoon.
Our team can finishing the prototype before Friday afternoon.
simple.explanation: Modal verb tidak pernah diikuti kata 'to' sebelum verb utama; langsung gunakan base verb 'finish'.

simple.prompt: Even from the back row, everyone ___ see the presentation slides clearly.
simple.explanation: 'Everyone' bersama semua subjek lainnya menggunakan 'can' + base verb 'see'.
hints: Modal 'can' berlaku sama untuk semua subjek.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya izin sederhana memakai 'Can I'.
simple.targetSentence: Can I leave my suitcase at the reception desk?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan izin santai: Can + I + base verb (leave) + object + place?
hints: Awali dengan 'Can I leave my suitcase'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat negatif kemampuan dengan ejaan baku satu kata 'cannot'.
simple.targetSentence: He cannot attend tomorrow's workshop due to travel.
simple.explanation: Bentuk negatif lengkap 'cannot' ditulis serangkai satu kata dalam penulisan formal.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih permohonan bantuan (request) yang sopan di lingkungan kerja.
dialogue: Manager
___ you please forward me the updated presentation slides?
Staff
Certainly, I will send them right away.
options: both 'Could' and 'Can' are correct, with 'Could' being more polite
intermediate.explanation: Baik 'Can you...?' maupun 'Could you...?' dapat digunakan untuk meminta tolong, dengan 'Could' bernada lebih santun dan formal.

intermediate.prompt: You ___ park your vehicle here; this space is strictly reserved for emergency ambulances.
intermediate.explanation: 'Cannot' atau 'can't' digunakan untuk menyatakan larangan mutlak (prohibition): Anda tidak diperbolehkan parkir di sini.

intermediate.prompt: Working late hours every night ___ lead to severe burnout.
intermediate.explanation: 'Can' digunakan untuk menyatakan kemungkinan teoretis atau fakta umum (theoretical possibility): hal tersebut memang mungkin terjadi.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat yang menyatakan kemampuan di masa lampau menggunakan 'could'.
intermediate.targetSentence: She could read when she was four years old.
intermediate.explanation: Bentuk lampau umum dari 'can' untuk kemampuan masa lalu adalah 'could'.

intermediate.prompt: Because the fire exit was unlocked, all occupants ___ escape safely from the building.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk keberhasilan melakukan tindakan pada satu kesempatan spesifik di masa lalu (specific past achievement), gunakan 'was/were able to', bukan 'could'.
hints: Keberhasilan pada satu peristiwa spesifik masa lalu.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat permintaan izin formal dengan 'Could I'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Could I ask a clarifying question about the timeline?
intermediate.explanation: Could I + base verb (ask) + object (a clarifying question) + prepositional phrase.
hints: Awali dengan permohonan santun 'Could I ask'.

dialogue: Detective
Could the suspect have committed the crime at 10 p.m.?
Officer
That ___ be true; he was on a live television broadcast at that hour.
intermediate.explanation: 'Can't' digunakan untuk menyatakan kepastian negatif/ketidakmungkinan logis (logical impossibility: pasti mustahil demikian).
hints: Menyatakan hal yang pasti mustahil benar.

intermediate.prompt: When she lived in Kyoto five years ago, she ___ read basic street signs quickly.
intermediate.explanation: Kemampuan umum di masa lalu ('five years ago') dinyatakan dengan bentuk lampau 'could'.
hints: Perhatikan keterangan waktu lampau 'five years ago'.
Lampau dari 'can' untuk kemampuan umum adalah 'could'.

intermediate.prompt: Notice the strict prohibition: 'Visitors ___ bring food or drinks inside the archival reading room.'
intermediate.explanation: Dalam pengumuman aturan resmi, 'cannot' digunakan untuk menyatakan hal yang dilarang/tidak diizinkan.
hints: Bermakna larangan resmi di ruang arsip.

dialogue: Client
Excuse me, ___ you send me a duplicate receipt by email?
Agent
Certainly, I'll dispatch it within five minutes.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam situasi layanan pelanggan atau profesional, 'Could you...?' terdengar lebih sopan dan halus daripada 'Can you...?'.

intermediate.prompt: Because the emergency ladder was accessible, everyone ___ escape safely before the smoke spread.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk keberhasilan satu aksi spesifik di masa lalu (berhasil menyelamatkan diri dalam satu peristiwa tertentu), gunakan 'was/were able to', bukan 'could'.
hints: Satu peristiwa keberhasilan nyata di masa lalu.
Untuk 'berhasil melakukan pada kejadian tertentu', pakai 'was able to'.

intermediate.prompt: Look at that glowing receipt—she ___ be the buyer, because her name isn't on the invoice!
intermediate.explanation: Untuk menyatakan keyakinan logis bahwa sesuatu MUSTAHIL benar saat ini ('pasti bukan...'), gunakan 'can't be' (bukan 'mustn't be').

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menyatukan 'can' dengan 'will' dalam kalimat masa depan berikut.
intermediate.draft: Once we upgrade the router, the office will can handle fifty simultaneous video calls.
options: Once we upgrade the router, the office will be able to handle fifty simultaneous video calls.
Once we upgrade the router, the office will could handle fifty simultaneous video calls.
Once we upgrade the router, the office can will handle fifty simultaneous video calls.
intermediate.explanation: Dua modal ('will' dan 'can') tidak boleh diletakkan berurutan; gunakan frasa padanan 'will be able to'.
hints: Modal 'will' tidak bisa diikuti 'can' secara langsung.

intermediate.prompt: Could you turn down the volume? I ___ hear the client on the phone.
intermediate.explanation: Situasi kesulitan mendengar yang sedang dialami sekarang memakai 'can't'.

intermediate.prompt: Even though the street was dark, our guide ___ locate the trailhead without GPS.
intermediate.explanation: Keberhasilan nyata pada satu momen lampau tertentu menggunakan 'was able to' (setara 'managed to').
hints: Berhasil menuntaskan aksi sekali di masa lalu.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat permohonan izin yang sangat sopan dengan 'Could I'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Could I borrow your charger until my laptop reaches fifty percent?
intermediate.explanation: 'Could I + base verb' adalah ungkapan sopan meminta izin.
hints: Awali dengan 'Could I borrow your charger'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat larangan formal untuk tamu.
intermediate.targetSentence: Guests cannot enter restricted laboratory zones without protective gear.
intermediate.explanation: Modal 'cannot' menyatakan larangan tegas bagi tamu.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan tata bahasa yang menumpuk dua modal verb bersamaan.
complex.draft: With enough training, you will can manage the entire regional team.
options: With enough training, you will be able to manage the entire regional team.
With enough training, you will could manage the entire regional team.
With enough training, you can will manage the entire regional team.
complex.explanation: Dua modal verb tidak boleh berdampingan ('will can' adalah salah). Untuk menyatakan kemampuan di masa depan bersama modal lain, ganti 'can' dengan frasa ekuivalennya: 'will be able to'.
hints: Gunakan bentuk ekuivalen 'will be able to'.

complex.prompt: He has been practicing intensely, so he ___ finish the marathon under four hours next week.
complex.explanation: Kemampuan di masa depan dengan modal masa depan diungkapkan dengan 'will be able to'.

complex.prompt: Look at the receipt! You ___ paid 500 dollars for that simple lunch; there must be a calculation error.
complex.explanation: Pola 'can't have + V3' (modal perfect) menyatakan deduksi ketidakmungkinan logis di masa lampau: mustahil kamu membayar sebanyak itu.
hints: Deduksi masa lampau yang mustahil terjadi.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi logis masa lampau.
complex.targetSentence: She can't have forgotten the appointment.
complex.explanation: Subject (She) + can't have + past participle (forgotten) + the appointment.
hints: Gunakan deduksi negatif masa lampau 'can't have forgotten'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi penggunaan idiom penolakan/keharusan 'cannot help but'.
complex.draft: Listening to her inspiring speech, I could not help to admire her perseverance.
options: Listening to her inspiring speech, I could not help admiring her perseverance.
Listening to her inspiring speech, I could not help admire her perseverance.
Listening to her inspiring speech, I cannot helped admiring her perseverance.
complex.explanation: Idiom 'cannot help' bermakna 'tidak bisa tidak/tak kuasa menahan diri untuk tidak...' dan harus diikuti oleh Gerund (verb-ing): 'could not help admiring'. (Atau varian 'cannot help but admire').

complex.prompt: The legal contract is so unambiguous that it ___ open to multiple interpretations.
complex.explanation: 'Cannot be' menegaskan kepastian logis bahwa hal tersebut tidak mungkin terbuka untuk tafsir ganda.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog analisis investigasi dengan bentuk modal past deduction.
dialogue: Auditor
Is it possible the accountant miscalculated the tax liabilities?
Senior Partner
No, with our automated verification, he ___ made such a rudimentary blunder.
complex.explanation: 'Could not have + V3' (atau can't have + V3) digunakan untuk menyatakan kemustahilan suatu peristiwa di masa lampau.
hints: Menyatakan hal lampau yang mustahil terjadi.

complex.prompt: The warehouse lights are completely off and the gate is locked; the night crew ___ still be inside.
complex.explanation: Untuk deduksi logis negatif saat ini ('mustahil masih berada di dalam'), gunakan 'can't' (bukan 'mustn't').
hints: Kesimpulan logis dari bukti lampu mati dan gerbang terkunci.

complex.prompt: I checked the pantry three times! You ___ have finished an entire jar of coffee in one morning!
complex.explanation: Untuk mengekspresikan rasa tak percaya atau ketidakmungkinan atas peristiwa masa lalu, gunakan 'couldn't have + V3' (atau 'can't have + V3').
hints: Pola deduksi masa lalu memakai 'couldn't have + V3'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan bentuk setelah 'has been able to' pada kalimat Present Perfect berikut.
complex.draft: After six months of coaching, Nadia has been can lead complex negotiations independently.
options: After six months of coaching, Nadia has been able to lead complex negotiations independently.
After six months of coaching, Nadia has could lead complex negotiations independently.
After six months of coaching, Nadia is able lead complex negotiations independently.
complex.explanation: 'Can' tidak memiliki bentuk Present Perfect ('has could' salah); gunakan 'has been able to + base verb'.
hints: Modal 'can' tidak punya bentuk past participle.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog analisis kasus hukum menggunakan idiom 'cannot help + V-ing'.
dialogue: Lawyer
Why did the witness pause so long during cross-examination?
Colleague
Notice the inconsistencies in the timeline—anyone reviewing those dates ___ noticing the gap.
complex.explanation: Idiom 'cannot help + V-ing' berarti 'tidak bisa menahan diri untuk tidak...' atau 'pasti merasakan/melihat'.

complex.prompt: Because the audit policy is crystal clear, the contract clause ___ possibly be misinterpreted.
complex.explanation: Penguat 'cannot possibly + bare infinitive' mengekspresikan ketidakmungkinan mutlak dengan gaya formal yang tegas.

complex.prompt: Without regular maintenance, even industrial servers ___ fail unexpectedly—note the general tendency expressed here.
complex.explanation: 'Can' juga berfungsi menyatakan kemungkinan teoritis atau kecenderungan umum ('bisa saja terjadi sewaktu-waktu').

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan bentuk kalimat dengan 'could' untuk peluang hipotesis masa lalu yang gagal terjadi.
complex.draft: With an extra week of preparation, the team could easily win last month's pitch competition.
options: With an extra week of preparation, the team could easily have won last month's pitch competition.
With an extra week of preparation, the team could easily won last month's pitch competition.
With an extra week of preparation, the team can easily have won last month's pitch competition.
complex.explanation: Kemungkinan lampau yang tidak terjadi ('seharusnya bisa menang bulan lalu') wajib memakai 'could have + V3': 'could easily have won'.
hints: Perhatikan konteks 'last month' dan syarat tak terpenuhi.

complex.prompt: Choose the formal equivalent of 'we couldn't avoid admiring the craftsmanship':
options: We could not but admire the craftsmanship.
We could not but admiring the craftsmanship.
We could not help admire the craftsmanship.
complex.explanation: Idiom sastra/formal 'cannot/could not but + bare infinitive' setara artinya dengan 'cannot/could not help + V-ing'.
hints: Setelah 'could not but', pakai kata kerja bentuk dasar.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi mustahil masa lampau dengan 'can't have'.
complex.targetSentence: They can't have missed the morning ferry by accident.
complex.explanation: 'Can't have + V3' menyatakan kesimpulan kuat bahwa sesuatu mustahil terjadi secara kebetulan.
hints: Akhiri dengan 'the morning ferry by accident'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat kemampuan hipotesis yang tidak sempat diambil.
complex.targetSentence: He could have accepted the fellowship, yet he chose industry.
complex.explanation: 'Could have accepted' menunjukkan peluang nyata di masa lalu yang tidak diambil.
hints: Mulai dengan 'He could have accepted the fellowship,'.
